fact_check.claim: Nolan takes first-year and sophomore applicants with at least 12 credits; juniors, seniors and bachelor's holders cannot apply; sophomores applying in spring enter as rising juniors
Deadline March 15, 2027, fall only; decisions May and June
Prerequisites: 3 units foreign language, 1 chemistry, 1 precalculus (HS or college); college microeconomics; college writing course meeting Knight Institute requirements
No minimum GPA; admits generally 3.3 or better; same figure as all admitted transfers
Up to 60 transfer credits, AP/IB/GCE capped at 15; AP Micro 5 = HADM 1410; IB Econ 7 = HADM 1410 + 3 electives; AP English 5 / IB English HL 7 = FWS; AP Statistics no credit
Interviews not offered; factors are coursework, essay (Writing Supplement), professor recommendations; resume listed only for first-year on Nolan page, central page lists resume for Hotel
fact_check.note: Matches brief, including the flagged conflict handling.

fact_check.claim: Contact sha_admissions@cornell.edu, +1 (607) 254-4228, 248 Sage Hall; registrar and advising emails, 180 Statler Hall

Internal route: Cornell GPA 3.0, ECON 1110 or equivalent, 12-credit term, first/second-year, essay up to 650 words; spring Dec 1, 2026 11:59 pm ET with decisions early January; fall May 1 with decisions by late June; office hours Nov 18, 2026; transferees ineligible
fact_check.note: Brief lists Oct 27 and Nov 18 office hours; page lists only Nov 18, the one still ahead on 2026-11-11.

fact_check.claim: Transfer Option: earlier portal login, no fee, resume for SC Johnson, deadline March 15 in 2026, next application opens winter 2027, decisions from mid-April, mostly late April or early May
fact_check.source_url: brief §2.2, §2.5 (TO deadline, extras, timing, Jan 2027 calendar)

fact_check.claim: $85 fee or waiver; waiver applied automatically when a burden and applicant applies for aid; March 15 and April 15 materials (College Report, Academic Evaluation, Mid-Term Report, transcripts); 250 to 650 word essay

Cornell says no preference by school type and about a quarter of transfers come from community colleges; 80% similarity, C or better, regionally accredited, not refused for community college or online
fact_check.note: Matches brief; 'about a quarter' attributed to Cornell's FAQ as the brief advises.

fact_check.claim: Nolan expected 48 fall and 21 spring transfers, 69 of 762 in 2021
fact_check.note: Brief gives Hotel 21/48/69 and total 762. Recomputed 48 + 21 = 69.

fact_check.claim: 864 of 7,381 transfer applicants admitted for fall 2025, 11.7%
Tuition $73,946 for 2026-27 (no NY resident break at endowed schools)
Our sum of tuition, $1,024 fees, a double and Unlimited comes to $96,318 billed
fact_check.note: Recomputed 73,946 + 1,024 + 13,744 + 7,604 = 96,318. A double is $6,872 per semester, so $13,744 a year.

fact_check.claim: Need-based aid only; families up to $125,000 with typical assets get tuition covered; up to $75,000, the full cost
CSS Profile and FAFSA by March 15, 2027; HEOP Transfer Certification form for Nolan (SC Johnson) EOP/HEOP applicants
Sophomore entrants must live on campus one academic year; junior entrants are exempt and can rent
fact_check.note: Fetched. The page says all new transfers live on campus for one academic year, and students who matriculate as a junior or senior are exempt.

fact_check.claim: Last day of instruction was December 7 in fall 2026, the deadline for the AP/IB credit request
fact_check.note: Fetched. The main fall 2026 term's last day of instruction is December 7, 2026.

fact_check.claim: Example: 30 college credits + 12 AP = 42, under both caps; 60 college credits leaves no room for AP
fact_check.note: 30 + 12 = 42, under 60 and under the AP cap of 15. 60 college credits already fills the 60 cap.

fact_check.claim: Rachel Eisenhart, an ILR transfer, wrote in the Sun that transfers repeat first-year small talk, feel in limbo at first, and feel like a regular sophomore within weeks
fact_check.note: Fetched. Author is Rachel Eisenhart, an ILR sophomore. Her wording: the 'where are you from, what's your major' game a hundred times in the first week; 'a feeling of limbo'; 'After a few weeks, you forget that you're a transfer student, you're just a sophomore.' The paraphrase matches. The page says 'an ILR transfer' and uses no pronoun.

fact_check.claim: Transfer GPA is not part of the Cornell GPA; transcript shows previous school name and total transfer credits
fact_check.note: Fetched. The registrar page says the transcript shows the transfer institution's name and total accepted transfer credits, and that the transfer GPA is not computed into the Cornell GPA.
